title: The section-ring restriction-and-division map is bijective
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], let $L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], and let $S$ be its graded section ring [def-sc-invertible-section-ring]. Let $s$ have positive degree $d$, and let $U$ be the nonvanishing open of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. If a ring map $\varphi:S_{(s)}\to\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_X)$ satisfies $\varphi(\xi/s^n)\,s^n|_U=\xi|_U$ for every homogeneous numerator $\xi$ of degree $nd$, then $\varphi$ is bijective. Neither ampleness nor affineness is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 01PW(2), degree-zero localization, used in Lemma 01Q1; equivalently coherent.tex Lemma 09MR with p=0

proof.text: Apply the degree-zero case of invertS_cohomology to the invertible module L tensorPow d and the structure module. Its comparison is an additive equivalence with sections on the nonvanishing open.

Use the left unitor, tensor-power associativity and degree-zero cohomology identification to express each numerator as a global section of L tensorPow (n*d). The additive fraction relations become exactly the equality relation in the homogeneous localization of the section ring: equality after multiplying by a further power of s. This identifies the localized Veronese presentation with Away S s. Identify the open supplied by the comparison with U by equality of their underlying sets.

The comparison equivalence and the given ring map satisfy the same formula on every fraction. Since s generates its invertible module on U, multiplication by every power is injective. Their images of each fraction agree. Every localization element is represented by one such fraction, hence the ring map is bijective. This includes the empty open and nilpotent sections, where both rings are zero.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 01PW(2), as applied to the Veronese ring in Lemma 01Q1

theorem sectionRing_localization_bijective
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible]
    [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (d : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (s : sectionRingGrade L d)
    (U : X.Opens) (hU : (U : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus (L.tensorPow d) (s.val d))
    (φ : CommRingCat.of (HomogeneousLocalization.Away (sectionRingGrade L) s.val) ⟶
      Γ(X, U))
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : sectionRingGrade L (n • d)),
      (φ (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.mk (sectionRingGrade L) s.property n
          ξ.val ξ.property)) •
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op ((s.val ^ n) (n • d)) =
        (L.tensorPow (n • d)).presheaf.map
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op (ξ.val (n • d))) :
    Function.Bijective φ
